verdict.rationale: Built-in tracing captures LLM generations, tool calls, handoffs, and guardrails as a comprehensive record, and the Traces dashboard lets developers debug, visualize, and monitor workflows in a dedicated observability UI. This is well documented as a first-party, out-of-the-box feature rather than requiring third-party tooling. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of the Traces dashboard in practice beyond vendor docs.
